text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With a win at the Japanese Derby,<n>Symboli Rudolf
carves her name next<n>to the greatest Umamusume
in<n>history.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She resolves to claim another crown<n>in the Kikuka
Sho, but her packed<n>schedule is starting to take its
toll, and<n>Air Groove is only getting more<n>concerned.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As usual, however, it's Symboli<n>Rudolf's way or
the highway. Even a<n>grueling race can't keep her
from her<n>student council duties.
